patterns.problem: A request has no disclosed preparation edge
patterns.method: Keep the isolated task and source states; do not invent parents
patterns.label: inferred
patterns.tradeoff: A simple disclosed graph can omit substantial preparation
patterns.failure_mode: Calling no recorded media proven direct or text-only production

patterns.problem: Reuse prepared sources for a new task
patterns.method: Bind a produced source with an explicit role/path
patterns.label: observed
patterns.tradeoff: Adds source/version decisions; reference content and frame timing remain unknown
patterns.failure_mode: Treating a reference image as an approved keyframe or a complete build order

patterns.problem: Explore or repeat requests from a source
patterns.method: Deduplicate raw media IDs and enumerate distinct consumers
patterns.sequence: source -> multiple candidates -> human choice proposal
patterns.label: observed
patterns.tradeoff: Shared context need not be a comparable iteration family
patterns.failure_mode: Calling recurrence approval, waste or independent tests
patterns.applicability: At least two actual media consumers; presets excluded

patterns.problem: Carry a candidate into another operation
patterns.method: Preserve explicit dependency stages and any named change
patterns.inputs: Producer output, consumer request and raw controls
patterns.sequence: producer -> derivative -> further consumer when disclosed
patterns.label: inferred
patterns.tradeoff: A path records dependencies but not why a revision was needed
patterns.failure_mode: Inferring rescue, difficulty, benefit or version approval from depth
patterns.applicability: One named edit stage; corpus depth proxy requires a parent with its own parent

patterns.problem: Connect recorded operations across literal models
patterns.method: Require a produced asset and actual material consumer; preserve both literal identifiers
patterns.label: observed
patterns.tradeoff: Unresolved origins and aliases limit the graph; co-occurrence remains distinct
patterns.failure_mode: Inferring routing, agents, a responsibility transfer or model superiority
patterns.applicability: Different nonempty identifiers on a resolved material edge

patterns.problem: External work is stated without a job graph
patterns.method: Retain statement and observed adapters in separate channels
patterns.inputs: Visible brief statement and/or typed job
patterns.sequence: known candidate -> unresolved external process; no invented timeline
patterns.label: creator-stated
patterns.tradeoff: Cannot enumerate the full sound/edit stack or final use
patterns.failure_mode: Promoting a tool mention or editor job to a verified final master
patterns.applicability: Scoped creator accounts alongside exported job evidence
